readmeMarkdown:
# Fleet An Antigravity sidecar plugin for multi-agent swarms. It reads native swarm boards, worker transcripts, `plan.json` milestones, and workspace git worktrees into a compact sidebar inside Antigravity. [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/cayleb-james2008/fleet/release.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cayleb-james2008/fleet/actions/workflows/release.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cayleb-james2008/fleet?style=flat-square&color=blue)](https://github.com/cayleb-james2008/fleet/releases/latest) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Sidecar%20Plugin-111318?style=flat-square)](https://cayleb-james2008.github.io/projects/fleet.html) [![Stack](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node%20ESM-React%2019%20%2B%20TS-3178c6?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cayleb-james2008/fleet) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/cayleb-james2008/fleet?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
--- ## Sidebar gallery Fleet lays out cleanly from a `340px` to `380px` auxiliary sidebar up to `1440px` desktop views. It listens for Antigravity `theme-change` luminance updates and keeps the manual Light and Dark switch inside Settings.
Triage and plan
 Board and pins
 Roster and telemetry
 Git worktrees

Board channels, Roster controls, and conflict hardening

Forensic transcript inspector

Model-aware spend, cache-hit economics, and 1M context ceilings

Cycle 3 E1 to E3 delta, transcript, and cost boundary hardening

Closed-loop operator command queue and Switch Model guard

Multi-swarm portfolio command drawer, triage ack/snooze, and swarm checkpoints

Swarm worktree discovery, conflict hunk inspection, and non-FF landing

Cycle 4 H1 hardening across borders, RPC timeouts, and error recovery

--- ## What it does In Triage, Fleet collects unanswered questions, blocked posts, quota pauses, stalled worker alerts, narrator `view.json` status, and normalized native or custom `plan.json` threads, tasks, and workstreams in one inbox, with persistent `Ack`, `Snooze` (until `#untilSeq`), `Unack`, and `Show acked` controls backed by `fleet_state.json`. A compact header Portfolio status pill opens the Portfolio Command Drawer (`GET /api/portfolio`), aggregating USD spend and token counts across active swarms, surfacing the cross-swarm urgent triage queue with `Jump to swarm`, gate state badges, and `Archive` / `Unarchive` toggles (`POST /api/swarm/archive`). A Checkpoints section (`GET/POST /api/checkpoints` and `POST /api/checkpoints/restore`) captures board heads, plans, members, and git worktree HEADs so operators can compare against live state, restore `plan.json` with CAS ETag protection, or copy and dispatch a continuation prompt. Operators edit goals, gates, tasks, and workstream statuses inline through atomic CAS `POST /api/plan` updates (using content-hash ETags and 3-way `Reload & merge` recovery on `409 Conflict`, plus optional coordinator notifications). Three header actions handle exports and handoffs: Copy Handoff Digest writes a sanitized Markdown summary (active goal, gate readiness, total USD spend, cache-hit rate, worker context and cost state, verified commits, blockers, and worktree readiness), while Archive .md and Archive .json download a sanitized Full Swarm Archive (`fleet.swarm-archive.v1` JSON or full Markdown transcript) without `/home/` path leaks. A worker attention strip surfaces idle, unread, and stalled workers with recovery prompts, filtered board jumps, and a 1-line `activityPeek` showing transcript tail status, tool summary, and age. When a live stream stalls or polling is paused, an inline SSE banner offers a 1-click Resync. A gate readiness card tracks `[done]`, `[verified]`, `[scale-verified]`, and `[blocked]` tags with a wave velocity pill, next-gate action button, gate verdict control (`verified`, `blocked`, or `ship`), and direct target jump. A bottleneck bar summarizes working, waiting, and blocked counts, and a model-aware token burn strip ranks workers by USD spend, reports cache-hit percentage and dollar savings, and plots each worker's share. Triage supports keyboard navigation (`j` and `k` to move, `o` or `Enter` to open chat, `p` to pin `#seq`, `r` to reply, `1` to `5` to switch tabs, `?` for help), inline activity peeks showing recent tool calls, unstick presets, `~/`-masked blocker copy buttons, and file openers through `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`. Pressing `Ctrl+K` or `Cmd+K` opens the Command Palette across tabs, `@worker` board filters, worker chats, triage items, recent board posts, worktrees, active swarms, the Portfolio Command Drawer, checkpoints, Ack/Snooze actions, the New Swarm launcher, Spawn Worker, and Board Post actions. A New Swarm launcher button also sits in the header when a swarm is active. In Board and Roster, an Operator Command Queue strip (`OperatorOpsStrip`) tracks every dispatched control operation and nudge from `fleet_ops.json` (a confined 64-entry ring buffer reconciled against `board.jsonl` `[opId=...]` citations, `members.json` state changes, `plan.json` updates, coordinator `ERROR_MESSAGE` logs, and 45s timeouts) with `Retry`, `Mark Verified`, `Dismiss`, and clickable `#seq` jump buttons. In Board, Fleet reads `board.jsonl` with channel filter tabs (`snap.channels`), an empty-channel fallback with quick reset controls, a Channel Manager drawer (`create`, `archive`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`), quick filters (`All`, `Needs reply`, `[done]`, `[blocked]`, cycled with `f`), server-persisted pinned posts (`POST /api/pins`), `#seq` quote replies, clickable `replyRefs` backlink chips (with filter recovery when jumping to hidden posts), a sticky confirmation-gated Board/Channel Composer (`channel` and `replyToSeq`), Markdown wave digests, and `.md` or `.json` board exports stripped of local `/home/` paths. In Roster, each worker card pairs duration badges, token breakdowns, model-aware USD spend (`Unpriced` for custom local models), cache-hit percentages, dynamic context saturation (`1M` for Gemini and 1M Claude variants, `400k` for GPT-5, `200k` for standard Claude and OpenAI o-series, and `128k` for GPT-4o), and an mtime-cached transcript tail `activityPeek` with worker recovery, filtered board jumps, an `Inspect trace` drawer (`ForensicTranscriptDrawer`), a Spawn Worker drawer, a Switch Model drawer (protecting active `working` workers with a `409 worker_not_waiting` guard and an explicit `Allow switch while working` override), a confirmation-gated Kill Worker flow (surfacing `409` unmerged worktree `dirtyFiles` and `ahead` warnings before Force kill), and a broadcast composer for `@all`, `working`, `waiting`, or custom worker subsets. Opening `Inspect trace` from Roster or Triage loads bounded pages from `GET /api/transcript` backwards (`All`, `Errors`, and `Tools` filters, paired `PLANNER_RESPONSE` tool arguments and `GENERIC` stderr tracebacks, `Load older steps` pagination, and scrubbed home paths and secrets). Board posts, channel operations, worker spawning, model switching, worker killing, and gate verdicts return immediately via non-blocking async RPC dispatch (`POST /api/control` and `POST /api/nudge` return `200` with `opId`, `status: "dispatched"`, and `coordinatorState`), surfacing coordinator health warnings when the coordinator is unavailable or paused. In Graph, a replayable `@mention` graph traces message flow across the swarm. In Git, Fleet auto-discovers workspace and active swarm member worktrees via `GET /api/worktrees?roots=...&conversationId=...` (`swarmOwner` badges with member status and workspace mode), flags overlapping `collisions` across active worktrees, shows recent commits and paginated (`<= 32 KiB` `nextOffset`/`hasMore`/`totalBytes`) `Working Changes`, `Branch Diff`, and `Conflict diff` hunks (`GET /api/worktrees/diff?mode=working|branch|conflict`), routes predicted or dry-run merge conflicts directly to the worktree owner with `Send conflict to @owner` (`POST /api/control`), and runs confirmation-gated `Dry-Run Merge`, `FF Merge`, `Rebase`, `Squash Merge`, `Merge Commit` (with optional `commitMessage` and automatic `409` abort on conflict), and clean `Remove` actions (`POST /api/worktrees/action`) with inline recovery hints. Live updates stream over `GET /api/swarm/stream` (`text/event-stream`) with ping heartbeats in standalone mode and pull incremental updates through `GET /api/swarm/delta` (`fs.watch` coalesced wakeup with a `125ms` fallback and `waitMs=20000` long-polling inside Antigravity's `SidecarApp` gateway, plus byte-offset `board.jsonl` tail caching and an `LRU=64` lightweight summary index in `swarm_store.mjs`). On startup, `main.mjs` binds the HTTP listener and answers `/api/health` immediately before lazily loading `server_core.mjs` (`swarm_store.mjs`, `git_probe.mjs`, and gzip caches) and `--jitless` V8 tuning flags after socket bind. When zero SSE clients are connected, `server_core.mjs` enters `idleSleep` and clears background polling timers until the next request or stream connection, serves cached `/api/worktrees` responses synchronously on cache hit, reads only the trailing 8 KB of each `transcript.jsonl` into a shared buffer for `activityPeek`, accumulates per-model `byModel` token and USD spend incrementally across model switches, scans transcript pages backwards in bounded `<= 512 KiB` slices on `GET /api/transcript`, and tails full history incrementally in 32 KB chunks without retaining parsed board graphs in memory. --- ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR Host["Antigravity Host
(Aux Side Pane + /preload.js)"] <-->|"SidecarApp RPC + theme-change
toggleConversation / toggleAuxPane"| Backend["Fleet Sidecar Bootstrap
(sidecars/fleet_pane/main.mjs)"] UI["Embedded Sidebar SPA
(435.8 KiB raw / 128.0 KiB gz)"] <-->|"GET /api/swarm/stream (SSE)
+ /api/swarm/delta + /api/portfolio + /api/checkpoints"| Backend Backend -->|"Lazy Route + Store Load"| Core["server_core.mjs + swarm_store.mjs"] Core -->|"Collision, Merge-Tree & Worktree Actions"| Git["git_probe.mjs"] Core -.->|"Read-Only 8 KB Tail + Scan"| Brain["~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conv>
.system_generated/{swarm,logs}"] Git -.->|"git status + rev-list + bounded diff"| WT["Workspace Git Worktrees"] ``` --- ## Verified benchmarks Measured under `#154` CPU isolation (`taskset -c 24-31`, 16 concurrent polling clients) on a 2,000-board-post and 50,000-transcript-line stress fixture: | Metric | v1.29.0 | v1.30.0 | **v1.31.0** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Embedded sidecar UI (`/`) | `429,110 B` raw (`419.1 KiB`) / `127,122 B` gz (`124.1 KiB`) | `435,483 B` raw (`425.3 KiB`) / `128,851 B` gz (`125.8 KiB`) | **`446,260 B` raw (`435.8 KiB`) / `131,034 B` gz (`128.0 KiB`)** | | Cold boot & RSS (`16w` audit) | `52.36 ms` / `109.61 MB` (`ETag 304`) | `49.11 ms` / `115.29 MB` (`ETag 304`) | **`37.64 ms` / `118.38 MB` (`ETag 304`)** | | Cold audit HTTP (`16w` close) | `1,584.9 req/s` / `14.81 ms` p95 (`0/3,975` errors) | `1,776.7 req/s` / `12.95 ms` p95 (`0/4,449` errors) | **`1,765.1 req/s` / `17.3 ms` p95 (`0/4,423` errors)** | | Simultaneous SSE (`x5` streams) | `5/5` (`0` drops) | `5/5` (`0` drops) | **`5/5` (`0` drops)** | | Raw-TCP fuzz & backend tests | `30/30` fuzz + `47/47` unit | `30/30` fuzz + `49/49` unit | **`30/30` fuzz + `52/52` unit** | | E2E gate, replay, and Sloplint | `72/72` + `8/8` + `30/30` live-web + `0 FAIL / 0 WARN` | `72/72` + `8/8` + `30/30` live-web + `0 FAIL / 0 WARN` | **`74/74` + `8/8` + `30/30` live-web + `0 FAIL / 0 WARN`** | --- ## Quick start Install the plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/fleet/`: ```bash ./install.sh ``` Open Antigravity Customizations (`customization://fleet`) to enable `fleet`, then open the side pane (`sidecar://fleet/fleet_pane/`) or run `/fleet` in chat to start a tracked swarm. > Note: Fleet became an Antigravity sidecar plugin in `v1.0.0`. The older standalone Rust binary remains at git tag `v0.12.0`. --- ## Security model The sidecar binds strictly to `127.0.0.1`, validates loopback `Host` headers (`403` otherwise), and checks `Origin` headers on mutating `POST` requests (`403`). Oversized request bodies fail early with `413 Payload Too Large` (`16 KiB` on worktree actions, `64 KiB` on plan writes and `/api/control`). `GET /api/frame` resolves paths with `realpath` inside `/brain/` and checks that each image appears on the board or `view.json`. `GET /api/transcript` resolves the member's `conversation_id` solely through `members.json` and `realpathSync` confinement under `/brain//.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl` (`400`/`404` on traversal, symlink escape, or missing member), scrubs `/home/` paths and secret tokens across text and tool payloads, and caps returned text and output previews. `git_probe.mjs` executes git via `execFile` without shell interpolation, confines diffs and `POST /api/worktrees/action` to resolved worktrees inside the repository, refuses dirty or unmerged removals, and clears `uri` for escaping symlinks. `POST /api/control` requires `confirm: true`, resolves the swarm coordinator conversation (`404` if missing, `501` outside live SidecarApp runtime), blocks unconfirmed kills of protected roles (`coordinator`, `narrator`, `monitor`), and returns `409 Conflict` with `dirtyFiles` and `ahead` counts before killing a worker with an unmerged worktree unless `forceUnmerged: true` is set. All nudges, broadcasts, control directives, and destructive worktree actions require user confirmation, external network requests are blocked by CSP, and every response carries `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`. --- ## Development and verification ```bash cd sidecars/fleet_pane && npm test cd ../../frontend && npm ci && npm run build:live-web npm run check:ui -- --lints node e2e/test-live-web.mjs ```
latestReleaseNotes:
Fleet v1.31.0 hardens JSON recovery, portfolio caching, git worktree probing, HTTP confinement, and sidebar error recovery across the Node sidecar and React UI inside Antigravity's auxiliary side pane.

### What changed

On the sidecar backend, `sidecars/fleet_pane/{swarm_store,git_probe,server_core,main}.mjs` strip UTF-8 BOMs from `fleet_ops.json` and `fleet_state.json`, bound file descriptor reads with `O_NOFOLLOW` and `fstatSync` size caps, keep valid sibling ops and checkpoints when skipping corrupt entries, and serialize writes with unique temporary files and 64-entry retention caps. `scanSwarmIds` and `streamLinesIncremental` exclude symlinks with `lstatSync`, and `portfolioCache` validates swarm signatures before reusing cached summaries. Concurrent git probes are capped at 4 (`GIT_CONCURRENCY = 4`), `SIGKILL` git timeouts return `504`, symlinked `.git` directories are rejected, unborn repositories, detached HEADs, missing branches, and Unicode paths (`core.quotepath=false`, `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`) resolve cleanly, and loopback `Host`, `Origin`, and path-traversal checks enforce `400` and `403` guards.

On the React sidebar frontend, `frontend/src/{index.css,ui.tsx,sidecar.ts,App.tsx}`, `frontend/src/components/{WorktreesView,TriageView}.tsx`, `frontend/vite.config.ts`, and `frontend/e2e/gate.mjs` move base component rules into `@layer components` with explicit variant borders so `Rebase` and worktree action buttons keep 1px borders in Light and Dark themes. All sidecar RPCs use `fetchWithTimeout` and `AbortSignal`, stalled or failed worktree actions and `Retry next 32 KiB` diff pagination provide `Abort` and `Retry` controls, worktree, portfolio, and checkpoint errors offer inline `Retry` recovery, triage ack and checkpoint actions use same-tick locks, and pending `OperatorOpsStrip` entries show elapsed wait times.

### Verified release metrics

All checks ran against `02c0011` under CPU isolation: `52/52` backend unit tests (`3,156.8 ms`), `74/74` Playwright gate checks, `8/8` replay checks, `30/30` `test-live-web.mjs` checks, `0 FAIL / 0 REFLEX / 0 WARN` Sloplint (`frontend/src` across 13 files and built `dist`, render tier ran), `446,260 B` raw / `131,034 B` gz sidecar HTML, `37.64 ms` cold boot, `118.38 MB` peak RSS, `1,765.1 req/s` (`17.3 ms` p95, `0/4,423` errors), `5/5` SSE streams (`0` drops), and `30/30` raw-TCP security fuzz checks.
